note: Pilot test set written by the group. Each English question has a Roman Urdu version with the same meaning. 'gold' lists phrases that appear only in the correct clause(s); a retrieved clause counts as correct if it contains any gold phrase. Unanswerable questions are about things the two regulation documents do not cover.

pairs.en: What is the minimum attendance required to sit in the final exam?
